An API-only user role and a custom service in Marketo Engage for the connection
A production Marketo Engage instance and a production Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics instance
Marketo people sync and Marketo programs switched on in Marketo Measure settings
The CRM lead and contact IDs on each Marketo person, so duplicates are detected
One period cost entry per month on each Marketo program
connections.availability_as_adobe_states_it: Adobe's programs page says: all tiers. It does not apply to Marketo Measure Ultimate, which has no direct Marketo Engage connection.

adobe_pages.title: Experience League: Marketo Engage programs integration

adobe_page.title: Experience League: Marketo Engage programs integration

services.quote_it_rests_on: Through the Marketo Measure integration with Marketo Engage Programs, our customers can begin to create touchpoints for attribution tracking from the Marketo Program Memberships.

connections.one_line: Marketo Measure destination exports B2B datasets from Experience Platform to Marketo Measure Ultimate
connections.how_it_works: Marketo Measure Ultimate takes its B2B data from Experience Platform: accounts, opportunities, contacts, leads, campaigns, campaign members and activities are ingested from the CRM and marketing automation sources into B2B datasets, and the Marketo Measure destination exports those datasets to Marketo Measure. Adobe describes it as an integration with Real-Time CDP B2B or B2P Edition.
what_must_be_true_first: Marketo Measure Ultimate, set up as a new implementation because Adobe gives no migration path from the tiers
An Experience Platform sandbox mapped in Marketo Measure settings first, a choice that cannot be changed in the application later
Datasets on B2B classes only, one dataset per class for each source, each in one dataflow
Account keys in the format Marketo Measure requires; the default Marketo Engage source mapping has to be changed first
Every stage mapped by hand for each dataset, because stages are not imported from the data
Reporting from the data warehouse or Discover, since Ultimate writes nothing back to the CRM
connections.availability_as_adobe_states_it: Adobe says the destination card is only available to Marketo Measure Ultimate customers.

adobe_pages.title: Experience League: Marketo Measure Ultimate destination

services.name: B2B schemas and dataflows for Marketo Measure Ultimate
services.what_the_partner_does: Create the B2B schemas, bring accounts, opportunities, contacts, leads, campaigns and activities from your client's CRM and marketing automation sources into Experience Platform datasets, and check each record against Marketo Measure's data requirements.

adobe_page.title: Experience League: Marketo Measure Ultimate overview

adobe_page.title: Experience League: Marketo Measure Ultimate destination

services.quote_it_rests_on: Use the Marketo Measure destination to export business-to-business (B2B) data from Adobe Experience Platform to Marketo Measure.

connections.one_line: B2B Customer Attributes: Marketo Measure account and revenue attributes on Adobe Analytics visitor profiles
connections.how_it_works: Marketo Measure fills an Experience Cloud Customer Attributes source with B2B attributes for known web visitors: account names, attributed revenue by model, deepest funnel stage and open opportunities, plus chosen CRM account fields. Adobe Analytics subscribes to the source, so the attributes can be used in segments and reports.
what_must_be_true_first: Active subscriptions to both Marketo Measure and Adobe Analytics
A Customer Attributes source created in the Experience Cloud console, with its alias ID and FTP details
Room under your client's contractual attribute limit in Adobe Analytics, which each subscribed attribute counts against
The full attribute list agreed before setup, because adding one later means deleting and recreating the connection
connections.availability_as_adobe_states_it: Adobe says it is available to all customers that use both Adobe Analytics and Marketo Measure.

adobe_pages.title: Experience League: Marketo Measure integrations with Adobe Analytics

services.name: B2B attributes from Marketo Measure in Adobe Analytics
services.what_the_partner_does: Create the Customer Attributes source, connect it in Marketo Measure with the account attributes to share, validate the schema with readable names, subscribe Adobe Analytics, and build your client's first account-based segments and reports.

adobe_page.title: Experience League: Marketo Measure integrations with Adobe Analytics

services.quote_it_rests_on: The B2B Customer Attributes integration enables mutual users of Marketo Measure and Adobe Analytics to enrich their Adobe Analytics user profiles with valuable metadata derived from the Marketo Measure attribution engine and through its sync capability with CRMs (Microsoft Dynamics and Salesforce).

connections.one_line: Analytics for Target (A4T): Analytics is the reporting source for Target activities, with every Analytics metric and segment on the report
connections.how_it_works: Analytics for Target (A4T) makes Adobe Analytics the reporting source for a Target activity: Target sends the activity and experience a visitor saw to Analytics server to server, and every Analytics metric and segment is available on the activity's report in both products. Analytics can also supply the behavioral data for Target Recommendations.
what_must_be_true_first: Licenses for both Adobe Analytics and Target
The account provisioned for A4T by Adobe, which your client requests with Adobe's integrations provisioning form
Web SDK with a datastream, or at.js with the Experience Cloud Visitor ID service and AppMeasurement at the minimum releases Adobe names on its page
Users who hold both an Analytics and a Target account, with access to the report suite and to the Web Services Access group
For Recommendations from Analytics data: product variables implemented in Analytics
connections.availability_as_adobe_states_it: Adobe says the account must be provisioned for the integration before A4T is used, and that provisioning can take up to five business days. Automated Personalization activities are not supported.

adobe_pages.title: Experience League: Adobe Analytics for Target (A4T)

services.name: A4T provisioning and implementation
services.what_the_partner_does: Request A4T provisioning with your client, set up user access to the report suite, enable Analytics in the datastream or bring the page libraries to the releases Adobe requires, set the reporting source in Target, and check that Target and Analytics hits share the same ID.

adobe_page.title: Experience League: Analytics for Target implementation

services.quote_it_rests_on: Several steps are required when implementing Adobe Analytics as the reporting source for Adobe Target (A4T).

adobe_page.title: Experience League: A4T reporting

services.quote_it_rests_on: In Analysis Workspace, use the Analytics for Target panel to analyze your Target activities and experiences with lift & confidence.

services.what_the_partner_does: Implement the product variables Recommendations needs in Analytics, create the Analytics classifications feed in Target, map its columns to Recommendations fields, and test a criteria that uses Analytics as its behavioral data source.

adobe_page.title: Experience League: Use Adobe Analytics with Target Recommendations

services.quote_it_rests_on: Using Adobe Analytics as the behavioral data source lets clients use the view-based and purchase-based behavioral data from Analytics in Adobe Target Recommendations activities.

connections.one_line: The Analytics source connector streams report suite data into Experience Platform datasets and Real-Time Customer Profile
connections.how_it_works: The Analytics source connector streams a copy of report suite data into an Experience Platform dataset in XDM format, where it can build Real-Time Customer Profiles and audiences. In the other direction, the Experience Cloud Audiences destination sends Real-Time CDP audiences to Adobe Analytics where your client also licenses Audience Manager.
what_must_be_true_first: Licenses for Adobe Analytics and Real-Time CDP, with the report suite mapped to the same organization as the Experience Platform sandbox
One dataflow for each report suite: a report suite can be ingested by a single active dataflow, in a single sandbox
A schema with the Adobe Analytics ExperienceEvent Template field group, default or custom
Variables that mean the same thing across report suites, or Data Prep mappings that resolve the conflicts, before more than one report suite is enabled for Profile
For audiences sent to Adobe Analytics: Real-Time CDP Prime or Ultimate, an Audience Manager license and the Visitor ID service
connections.availability_as_adobe_states_it: Not stated by Adobe for the source connector. Adobe says the Experience Cloud Audiences destination is available to Real-Time CDP Prime and Ultimate customers, and that sending audiences to Adobe Analytics needs an Audience Manager license.

adobe_pages.title: Experience League: Adobe Analytics source connector for report suite data

services.name: Analytics source connector and field mapping
services.what_the_partner_does: Create the source dataflow for each agreed report suite, choose the default or a custom schema, map eVars, props and events to named XDM fields with Data Prep, and check the live data and the history backfill in the dataset.

adobe_page.title: Experience League: Adobe Analytics source connector for report suite data

services.quote_it_rests_on: The connector streams report suite data into a Platform dataset in real time, converting it to XDM format.

services.what_the_partner_does: Review the report suite's privacy labels, mark the matching schema fields as identities, apply data usage labels by hand, and agree with your client how privacy requests are handled for the Analytics dataset before it is enabled for Profile.

services.what_the_partner_does: Where your client also licenses Audience Manager, connect the Experience Cloud Audiences destination, choose which Real-Time CDP audiences to share, and check that they arrive in Audience Manager and show in Analytics.

adobe_page.title: Experience League: Experience Cloud Audiences connection

services.quote_it_rests_on: Use this destination to activate audiences from Real-Time CDP to Audience Manager and Adobe Analytics.

connections.one_line: Report suite data reaches CJA through the Analytics source connector; Analytics projects and components migrate to CJA data views
connections.how_it_works: Report suite data reaches Customer Journey Analytics through the Analytics source connector: one dataflow for each report suite lands the data in an Experience Platform dataset, and a CJA connection and data view make it reportable beside other channels. Adobe Analytics administrators can then re-create Analytics projects and their components in CJA with the Component migration tool.
what_must_be_true_first: Licenses for Adobe Analytics and Customer Journey Analytics, with Analytics deployed on at least one site
For more than one report suite in a connection: the CJA Select package
Report suite variables aligned, or a Data Prep mapping, before report suites are combined

For project migration: Adobe Analytics administrator rights, a connection and data view that already hold the report suite data, and an agreed mapping of dimensions and metrics for the whole organization
Projects on base report suites only: panels on a virtual report suite cannot be migrated
connections.availability_as_adobe_states_it: Not stated by Adobe for the source connector. Adobe says analysis across more than one report suite needs the CJA Select package, and that project migration in the Analytics interface is for Adobe Analytics administrators.

adobe_pages.title: Experience League: Use Adobe Analytics report suite data in Customer Journey Analytics

services.name: Report suite data in CJA
services.what_the_partner_does: Create a source dataflow for each agreed report suite, resolve prop and eVar differences across report suites with Data Prep, add the datasets to a CJA connection with the right person ID, and define the data view's dimensions and metrics.

services.what_the_partner_does: Run the Analytics inventory, agree with your client how dimensions and metrics map for the whole organization, remove the panels CJA does not support, migrate the agreed projects in batches and check each one against its original.

adobe_page.title: Experience League: Migrate components and projects from Adobe Analytics to Customer Journey Analytics

services.quote_it_rests_on: Adobe Analytics administrators can migrate Adobe Analytics projects and their associated components to Customer Journey Analytics.

connections.one_line: Report suite events, streamed through the Analytics source connector, trigger journeys through rule-based events
connections.how_it_works: Web behavior that Adobe Analytics already captures can trigger journeys: the Analytics source connector is enabled for a report suite, Adobe enables the Journey Optimizer environment to use that data source, and a rule-based event on the Analytics schema starts or advances a journey.
what_must_be_true_first: Licenses for Adobe Analytics and Journey Optimizer
The Analytics source connector enabled for the report suite, on a default or custom schema
The Journey Optimizer environment enabled by Adobe Customer Care for the Analytics data source, requested with the organization ID and the data source ID
Rule-based events: this route does not apply to other event types
connections.availability_as_adobe_states_it: Adobe says the Journey Optimizer environment must be enabled by Adobe to use an Adobe Analytics data source, on request to Adobe Customer Care, and that this applies to rule-based events only.

adobe_pages.title: Experience League: Adobe Analytics integration

adobe_page.title: Experience League: Adobe Analytics integration

connections.one_line: Marketo Web Personalization adds organization, industry, segment and web campaign data to Analytics reports
connections.how_it_works: Marketo Web Personalization (Real-Time Personalization) writes each visitor's organization, industry, segment and web campaign into conversion variables, events and props in an Adobe Analytics report suite, set up in Analytics admin and switched on in the Web Personalization account settings.
what_must_be_true_first: Marketo Engage with Web Personalization (Real-Time Personalization) and its tag on the site
Free conversion variable, success event and traffic variable slots in the report suite, enabled in Analytics admin
The same slot numbers set in the Web Personalization account settings
For Marketo lists in Analytics reports instead: an Audience Manager license, which that route depends on

services.quote_it_rests_on: Analyze your web analytics from a B2B perspective by viewing organization, industry and Marketo Real-Time Personalization (RTP) campaign data within your Adobe Analytics account.

connections.one_line: An IMS-authenticated Analytics configuration in AEM as a Cloud Service, with the Analytics extension in tags sending page data
connections.how_it_works: AEM as a Cloud Service connects to a report suite through an Analytics cloud configuration that uses IMS authentication, and the site is tagged through a tags property that carries the Adobe Analytics extension, with rules that send page data to Analytics.
what_must_be_true_first: AEM as a Cloud Service and an Adobe Analytics license with a report suite for the site
An IMS configuration in AEM, set up with server-to-server OAuth
A tags property for the site with the Adobe Analytics extension
IMS and tags in place of the older Analytics frameworks in AEM, which no longer work

adobe_pages.title: Experience League: Integrating with Adobe Analytics

adobe_page.title: Experience League: Integrating with Adobe Analytics

connections.one_line: Assets Insights shows image impressions and clicks in AEM Assets, read from an Analytics report suite
connections.how_it_works: Assets Insights reads impressions and clicks for images from an Adobe Analytics report suite that has AEM Assets Reporting enabled, through the Analytics API with a server-to-server credential, and shows usage scores on each image and folder in AEM Assets.
what_must_be_true_first: AEM Assets as a Cloud Service and an Adobe Analytics license
AEM Assets Reporting enabled on the report suite used for Assets Insights
An Adobe Developer Console project with the Adobe Analytics API and a server-to-server OAuth credential
Images only: other asset types get no insights

adobe_page.title: Experience League: Assets Insights

services.quote_it_rests_on: Experience Manager Assets fetches usage data about digital assets deployed on third-party websites directly from Adobe Analytics.

connections.one_line: Adobe's martech plugin sends Edge Delivery page views and events through Web SDK to an Analytics report suite
connections.how_it_works: On an Edge Delivery Services site, Adobe's martech plugin loads Web SDK, the Adobe Client Data Layer and tags in a way that protects page speed, and sends page views and custom events through a datastream to an Adobe Analytics report suite once the page has rendered.
what_must_be_true_first: The aem-martech plugin installed in the site's code repository from Adobe's GitHub project, which the tool's other Edge Delivery cards describe as coming through AEM Engineering
Adobe Analytics, and Target or Journey Optimizer, which the plugin guide lists together
A datastream connected to the Analytics report suite
A tags container with the Adobe Client Data Layer extension, and without the Web SDK or Analytics extensions, which the plugin adds itself
A consent platform connected to the plugin, which holds consent as pending by default
connections.availability_as_adobe_states_it: Not stated on the aem.live page. The tool's Target and Real-Time CDP cards for Edge Delivery describe the same plugin as available through AEM Engineering.

adobe_page.title: aem.live: Configuring Adobe Experience Cloud Integration

connections.one_line: Commerce's Data Connection extension sends storefront events through a datastream to an Analytics report suite
connections.how_it_works: The Data Connection extension (the Experience Platform connector) sends Adobe Commerce storefront events to the Edge Network, and a datastream with the Adobe Analytics service forwards them to a report suite, on a schema that carries the Adobe Analytics commerce field group.
what_must_be_true_first: Adobe Commerce with the Data Connection extension installed and configured
Access to Adobe Analytics for the organization, and a report suite for the Commerce data
An XDM schema with the Adobe Analytics ExperienceEvent Commerce field group
A datastream with the Adobe Analytics service and the report suite ID
connections.availability_as_adobe_states_it: Not stated by Adobe. The tutorial is written for Adobe Commerce cloud projects and says self-hosted projects can vary.

connections.one_line: Acrobat Sign cloud configuration in AEM Forms sends form documents for signature, from a workflow step or a sign-enabled form
connections.how_it_works: AEM Forms connects to Acrobat Sign through a cloud service configuration on the Author and Publish instances, backed by an Acrobat Sign API application. AEM Forms supports Acrobat Sign and Acrobat Sign Solutions for Government.
what_must_be_true_first: An active Acrobat Sign developer account and an Acrobat Sign API application, for its Client ID and Client Secret
The cloud configuration pointed at the Acrobat Sign shard the account lives on
For forms on Core Components: signing through the Sign Document workflow step, since signing inside the form is not supported
An email address for every signer
For Government ID checks: that authentication method enabled in Acrobat Sign
connections.availability_as_adobe_states_it: Adobe says AEM Forms supports both Adobe Acrobat Sign and Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for Government.

adobe_page.title: Experience League: Use Adobe Sign in an Adaptive Form

connections.one_line: Workfront Fusion modules create Acrobat Sign agreements from Workfront work and act on agreement events
connections.how_it_works: Workfront Fusion's Acrobat Sign modules connect the two products: a scenario starts when an agreement is created or changes, and scenarios create, read and update agreements, upload documents and search records. An Acrobat Sign account with API access, connected to Fusion
A new agreement for each request, since agreements are not typically changed once started
The document uploaded as a transient document and mapped to the agreement
connections.availability_as_adobe_states_it: Not stated by Adobe for the pair; Adobe documents the Acrobat Sign modules in Workfront Fusion.

The Marketo Engage sync with that CRM installed and running
For text messages: a Marketo SMS feature purchased or configured
connections.availability_as_adobe_states_it: Not stated by Adobe; Adobe documents the route in tutorials that place a CRM between the two products.

adobe_page.title: Experience League: Send reminders using Acrobat Sign for Salesforce and Marketo

services.quote_it_rests_on: Learn how to send an email reminder from Marketo when an agreement remains unsigned after a period of time.

connections.one_line: Request e-signatures in Acrobat sends through Acrobat Sign, and forms authored in Acrobat become Acrobat Sign fields

Field names in Acrobat forms that carry an Acrobat Sign text tag
connections.availability_as_adobe_states_it: Adobe states availability feature by feature for Acrobat Standard and Acrobat Pro, Acrobat Sign Solutions and Acrobat Sign for Government.

adobe_page.title: Experience League: Accelerate your sales process (Acrobat Services tutorial)

services.quote_it_rests_on: With Adobe Document Generation Tagger, you can easily place these Text Tag fields.

connections.one_line: Workfront Fusion's Adobe PDF Services modules generate, convert, combine and read PDFs inside a scenario

connections.one_line: A Marketo Engage webhook sends live activity to Marketo Qualifier, and activity sync writes outreach activities back to Marketo Engage

Marketo Engage sends live activity to Marketo Qualifier through a webhook: an administrator creates OAuth Server-to-Server credentials in the Adobe Developer Console, sets up the webhook in Marketo Engage with Adobe's payload template and headers, and adds it as a Call Webhook step to a trigger Smart Campaign whose triggers decide which activities are sent. Representatives then see and filter prospects by that activity under Marketing Highlights, and an Outbound Workflow can enroll prospects whose activity matches its targeting. In the other direction, activity sync writes Marketo Qualifier outreach activities to Marketo Engage, and representatives can add a contact to a Marketo campaign from the account view or from Salesforce.

A trigger Smart Campaign in Marketo Engage, existing or new, whose triggers decide which activities are sent
For outreach activities in Marketo Engage: activity sync turned on, which needs write access in your client's CRM
For automatic enrollment: each prospect owned in the CRM by the representative whose workflow should take it, because the owner is resolved by email
